name: memrain
description: Connect Codex to your Memrain memory over MCP: search, read and write pages, facts and timelines shared across sessions, plus a small set of skills for working with it.

interface.shortDescription: Shared memory for your agents over MCP
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to a Memrain server: search, pages, facts, timelines and the entity graph, kept across sessions and shared with your other agents. The server runs on your own AWS account or on this machine (`make local-up`, keyword-only, no AWS). Export BRAIN_MCP_TOKEN with a personal access token before starting Codex. The plugin points at the local quickstart (http://127.0.0.1:18790/mcp); for a deployed server, set its URL under [mcp_servers.memrain] in ~/.codex/config.toml.
defaultPrompt: Search my Memrain memory for what we know about this project
